## One-round compaction: live AI text
- The `pi-one-round-compaction` panel now **streams the real model text**: the plugin's per-lane `delta` frames are appended verbatim and the live panel shows a rolling three-line tail window under each lane status line, with a `…` marker for clipped content. Text is plain while streaming (no partial-Markdown flicker) and memory is bounded to a 20k-character tail per lane.
- Lane text is tab-owned: it resets per compaction run and clears on completion, failure, abort, process exit, or stale status.

## Stability
- Fixed the sudden `MaxListenersExceededWarning` from the terminal renderer. Every scrollbox registers one long-lived `selection` listener on the shared renderer, so a conversation with 11+ expandable tool outputs/diffs crossed node's default 10-listener warning threshold. The renderer's listener limit is now raised at bootstrap; the warning no longer appears in the status bar or run logs.
